title: High Five Orange Rolls
description: These breakfast rolls get a triple dose of orange flavor from juice, zest, and extract. Delicious when served warm with a sweet cream cheese frosting!
ingredients: 5 cups bread flour, or more if needed
2 tablespoons milk, or more as needed

steps.text: Dough: Whisk milk, water, and sugar together in a small bowl. Sprinkle yeast over mixture. Let stand until yeast begins to bubble and get foamy, about 5 minutes. Whisk in egg, juice, butter, pudding, and extract.

Whisk flour and salt together. Stir flour mixture into orange mixture, adding more flour 1 tablespoon at a time if dough is too sticky. When dough comes together, turn out onto a lightly floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic, 8 to 10 minutes.
Place dough in an oiled bowl and cover with a clean cloth. Let rise in a warm place until doubled in size, about 1 1/2 hours.
Filling: Mix butter, zest, and extract together in a small bowl until smooth. Set aside. Grease a baking sheet, or cover with parchment paper.

Turn dough out on a floured surface and roll out into a 24x12-inch rectangle. Spread filling evenly over dough, then sprinkle with sugar. Roll the dough into a spiral, beginning on a long side. Cut dough into 18 rolls, 1/2-inch thick. Arrange rolls, cut-side up, on the prepared baking sheet. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight.
Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Remove the plastic wrap from rolls and let rise in a warm place, about 30 minutes.
Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, 25 to 30 minutes. Let cool slightly before frosting.

Frosting: Cream together cream cheese, and butter until smooth. Stir in confectioners' sugar and extract. Add milk a little at a time until frosting is smooth and spreadable. Spread frosting over rolls.
